correctness.rationale: Analytical proof reconstructs conditional payoff differences, derives exact update drift and threshold, proves strict intensity monotonicity and compact uniform weak/high-strength limits. Its global z²/(2 sinh z) inequality justifies the nontrivial maximization limit; strict concavity yields the unique universal z*. An exact double-angle identity proves the rational opposite-sign witness; global defection convergence is proved for strict all-negative drift. Standalone exact symbolic and 55-digit checks reproduced independent quantitative consequences without replacing infinite-domain proof.

value.rationale: A concrete environmentally variable three-person public good has a rigorously sharp threshold in nonlinear learning intensity that reverses the sign of cooperative selection relative to the commonly used average-before-Fermi protocol. Strict threshold monotonicity, a universal 1/s asymptotic with uniquely determined constant, and an exact rational witness are non-routine consequences that clarify when environmental averaging and individual learning order matter. The precise result offers a motivated modeling benchmark, while limited to its stated common-shock mean-field protocol.
